question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP initialize request (jsonrpc 2.0, protocolVersion 2025-06-18, clientInfo public-agents-researcher 1.0), Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream

headers.www-authenticate: Bearer realm="OAuth", resource_metadata="https://mcp.rippling.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp", error="invalid_token", error_description="Missing or invalid access token"

decoded.challenge: the Bearer scheme; realm OAuth; resource_metadata https://mcp.rippling.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp; error invalid_token; error_description "Missing or invalid access token"
decoded.protected-resource-metadata: 403 at the URL the challenge names, as a Cloudflare block page in HTML ("Attention Required!", "Sorry, you have been blocked", "You are unable to access mcp.rippling.com"), to this datacenter IP with curl; no JSON document was readable
decoded.authorization-server-metadata: not reachable from here: the resource document is blocked, so no authorization server is named
decoded.rest: not measured: the entry names no REST base URL, and this probe stayed on the MCP surface the vendor documents

finding: With no credentials, an MCP initialize POST to mcp.rippling.com/mcp answers 401 with a complete challenge: the Bearer scheme, realm OAuth, a resource_metadata URL, error invalid_token and a description. The URL it names answers 403 to this datacenter IP as a Cloudflare block page in HTML rather than a JSON document, so the discovery chain the challenge starts ends at its first link: no resource document, therefore no authorization server, registration endpoint or scope list can be read from here. Whether a client on a residential network reads the document is not measured today; the 2026-09-13 note in the entry recorded the same 403 in a browser as well as in curl. No REST request was made: the entry names no API base, and this probe stays on the surface the vendor documents. Same 401 and same 403 as the 2026-09-13 measurement, now on the record with the challenge's exact parameters. Nothing here measures what the server does with a credential.
